extensionDescription: An extension to identify and remove duplicate favorites (a.k.a bookmarks) in Microsoft Edge web browser.
notByAiMessage: This extension is primarily made by a human.
actionHint: Click "Get Favorites" to display your current favorites/bookmarks.
infoInitial: Your favorites/bookmarks will be visible here...
successDeletion: You have successfully deleted all the duplicate bookmarks!
confirmDelete: This action cannot be undone. Do you wish to continue?
searchEmptyFolders: Do you want to search for empty folders?
emptyFoldersRemoved: All empty folders have been removed!
noEmptyFolders: No empty folders have been found!
